properties.NAME: AUSTIN
properties.CHANGE: SAN FELIPE DE AUSTIN (now AUSTIN, original county) established as a municipality by Mexico. Precise boundaries were not described; municipality had jurisdiction between Lavaca and San Jacinto Riv., and south of the San Antonio Road to the Gulf of Mexico.
properties.CITATION: ("Austin County," New Handbook of Texas, 1:305; Barker, 299-307)
